description: Keep track of today's meetings, schedule, and daily agenda without external dependencies. Import iCalendar (.ics) files, organize your time blocks, and display your next upcoming meeting directly on your Appshell desktop dashboard. 100% offline and private.
tagline: Private offline daily agenda and schedule planner.
highlights: 100% offline with zero external network requests
Interactive today agenda and time-block tracking
Live dashboard widget for upcoming meetings
whatsNew: Fully offline schedule management with .ics import and widget support.
